subject: Midwest Health — Disaster Recovery & Continuity: Technical responses and runbook attachments
content:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@midwesthealth.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@midwesthealth.org>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Midwest Health DR questionnaire: follow-ups on RTO/RPO and failover

Hannah,

Thanks for the initial packet — the procurement team has a few follow-ups specifically around RTO/RPO for the different deployment modes (hosted API, Dedicated, and Private VPC) and how cross-region failover is handled without losing in-flight sessions. Please see the three items below we need clarified for the evaluation:

1) Concrete RTO and RPO numbers for each deployment mode (including assumptions about model cache warming).
2) How the platform handles multi-region failover for low-latency interactive sessions (session affinity, KV cache replication, and user-visible impact).
3) Evidence of DR testing cadence and results (we need the most recent test summary).

Can you respond with specifics we can include in the technical evaluation? If you have a DR runbook and the last test report, please attach.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, IT Procurement — Midwest Health
